_about: Rules for Cast on X (meta gem) energy, which Path of Building does not model. Edit numbers here, not in code. 'verified' turns true per rule once an in-game check matches (see engine/tools/trigger_check.py).

monster_power._source: community figures (Mobalytics monster power guide, poe2wiki): base power x rarity, unique bosses 20

threshold_scaling._about: Energy per crit is multiplied by (crit damage / enemy ailment threshold), at most `cap`.
threshold_scaling._mapping_note: Map monsters: crits usually deal more than a normal monster's whole ailment threshold, so the ratio is taken as the cap.
threshold_scaling._source: poe2db Cast on Critical text: 'modified by the percentage of the enemy's Ailment Threshold the Critical Hit will deal'. The cap is our assumption.

cast_on_crit._source: Path of Building gem data (MetaCastOnCritPlayer, SupportMetaCastOnCritPlayer) and poe2db

cast_on_elemental_ailment._note: Energy from Ignite and Shock only: PoE 2 Freeze builds up over hits and PoB gives no per-hit freeze chance, so freeze energy is left out (a conservative estimate). No ailment-threshold scaling (the gem text doesn't mention it).
cast_on_elemental_ailment._source: Path of Building gem data (MetaCastOnElementalAilmentPlayer: 100 / 100 / 1000 centienergy per monster power on ignite / shock / freeze, energy_generated_+% 3 per level)

thundergods_wrath._note: Energy on every melee hit (not only crits), modified by the percentage of the enemy's Ailment Threshold the hit deals (game text, poe2db; PoB's data leaves the threshold part out). No damage penalty in the support data. Level bonus: quality only (energy_generated_+% 0.75 per quality), so 0 here.
thundergods_wrath._source: Path of Building gem data (MetaCastLightningSpellOnHitPlayer / MetaCastFireSpellOnHitPlayer: 300 centienergy per monster power on hit; 1 max energy per 10 ms of socketed cast time) and poe2db text

fire_spell_on_melee_hit._note: Energy on every melee hit (not only crits), modified by the percentage of the enemy's Ailment Threshold the hit deals (game text, poe2db; PoB's data leaves the threshold part out). No damage penalty in the support data. Level bonus: quality only (energy_generated_+% 0.75 per quality), so 0 here.
fire_spell_on_melee_hit._source: Path of Building gem data (MetaCastLightningSpellOnHitPlayer / MetaCastFireSpellOnHitPlayer: 300 centienergy per monster power on hit; 1 max energy per 10 ms of socketed cast time) and poe2db text
